verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a single line saying Auth0's Private Cloud deployment includes "dev instances," which implies a non-production environment separate from production. It is limited to the dedicated managed-cloud offering and gives no detail on how test data is kept separate from production. Missing for 10: documented sandbox or dev tenant setup on standard plans, explicit isolation of test data from production data, guidance for AI-agent or CLI/MCP testing against a non-production tenant, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: A dedicated, managed cloud service running on AWS providing isolation, higher performance, dev instances, Geo-HA add-ons and more
